result.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/001 on medical devices MDR Article 97 compliance
result.content: This Regulation establishes additional technical requirements for medical devices under MDR (EU) 2017/745.

result.title: Commission Decision (EU) 2024/002 on IVDR transition provisions for legacy in vitro diagnostic devices
result.content: This Decision extends the transition period for certain in vitro diagnostic devices under IVDR (EU) 2017/746.
